**I’d start with three parallel tracks: finish localization reporting, fix Brewfile export, and prepare unified Updates.** I checked live issues/PRs against current `main`.

| Track | Concrete next slice | Parallel fit |
|---|---|---|
| **Localization — [#142](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues/142)** | Repair [PR #166](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/pull/166), then translate a bounded group of strings. CI crashes because its `metadata` test helper collides with Minitest; the PR also has a merge conflict. | Mostly scripts and localization files, independent of application logic. |
| **Brewfile export correctness** | Run export off the main thread and determine failure from the command result. Currently it can freeze the UI and miss errors whose output doesn’t begin with `Error:` or `fatal:`. | A small, useful bugfix. Separate operation controller from Updates, with some shared integration files. |
| **Unified Updates — [#147](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues/147)** | First extract and test upgrade planning, wired into the existing upgrade action. Then build the combined formula/cask destination. | Planning and focused implementation can proceed alongside export; coordinate shared mocks and tests. |

The strongest code findings behind that recommendation:

- [Export failure handling](/Users/scottdensmore/Developer/scottdensmore/cakebrew/Cakebrew/BPHomebrewInterface.m:829) discards command success and searches diagnostic text instead. A regression test should cover failed commands with empty or unfamiliar output.
- [Upgrade dispatch](/Users/scottdensmore/Developer/scottdensmore/cakebrew/Cakebrew/Controllers/BPInstallationWindowController.m:204) chooses formula versus cask from the first selected item. Unified Updates needs separate batches, distinct namespace identities, and an empty selection that runs nothing.
- The main view controller is now **1,513 lines**. A broad operations extraction under [#143](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues/143) would overlap both features; keep that work focused on the upgrade seam for now.

There’s also existing work to finish: search [PR #165](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/pull/165) and its dependent fix [#167](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/pull/167) both have green CI. Complete their review/merge sequence before integrating new Updates navigation.

**Defer self-update [#149](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues/149):** it explicitly depends on the first signed release in [#145](https://github.com/scottdensmore/Cakebrew/issues/145), and the repository still has no releases.

Use isolated worktrees for the three tracks, coordinate shared controller/mock/test edits, and serialize UI runs. This was a read-only assessment; the export findings are source-confirmed, with runtime reproduction still needed.
